messages:
Mara: opened a PR to update release notes + migration guide for the model catalog changes (deprecation + new quantized variants). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482
Joel: nice — can you @ the release owners? we need a reviewer for the sdk snippet and the changelog entry. @Sam @Anya? :eyes:
Sam: I can take the SDK snippet (python & js). will run through the examples tonight. any required behavior changes for tokenization I should be aware of?
Anya: I'll add the short migration bullets for prompt tokenization and deprecated model names. also fixed one broken link in models/index.md in the PR.
ci-bot: build failed: docs preview linkcheck error in models/index.md:78 -> https://old-models.redwood.ai/compatibility (404)
Mara: thanks — I'll remove the old link and replace with the compatibility matrix. plan is to merge once CI is green so this makes next minor release. any reason to hold?
Joel: no objections. prefer not to promote to canary until we confirm runtime fallback behavior, but merging to main is fine after green. please add the changelog label and note the deprecation window.
Sam: LGTM for the SDK snippet; left one nit about showing async streaming example vs sync. small patch incoming.
Anya: pushed migration note for quantized variants + timeline (sunset dates). also updated the models table to show replacement suggestions.
ci-bot: all checks passed. preview available: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.ai/ (render looks good)
Mara: preview looks good on desktop and mobile. I'm planning to merge at 17:30 PT unless anyone asks for a hold.
Joel: go for it. remember to tag release-note and add the changelog entry under 'model-catalog' with the deprecation flag.
Sam: thanks — added an async streaming snippet and a short remark about behavior change; will open a follow-up to expand tests.
Mara: merged PR #482 to main. changed link and migration guide included.
deploy-bot: PR 482 merged by Mara -> main; automated deploy started (production in ~10m).
Anya: done a quick smoke check on staging — routing fallback works for the deprecated model alias. filed ticket #1056 to update python-snippets repo with the new example.
Mara: awesome, thanks team! :tada: If any customer-facing wording needs tweaks, we can follow up in a small PR.
Joel: noted. I'll patch the changelog entry to include a migration checklist and a short FAQ blurb.
Sam: ping me when the snippets ticket is up, I'll take it.
Mara: closing thread here — thanks for the quick reviews and fixes.
